recipes.title: Change the header phone link
steps: Open WordPress admin for the approved site. Select Appearance > Editor.
Open Patterns > Manage all template parts > Header. Confirm the preview matches the reviewed before-crop; stop for review if the labels or header differ.
Select the header Phone link block in List View. Replace its visible text with {new_text}.
Edit that block's link destination to {new_href} and apply the link change.

Select Save, confirm only the Header template part is selected, and confirm Save again. Wait for the saved confirmation. This fixture has no WordPress cache plugin; any other cache configuration requires a separately validated recipe.
Open {page_urls} at {viewports} widths. Confirm the header shows {new_text} and its link destination is {new_href}, then return to the job card and select Mark done.
